shared_elements: schematic human figure with outstretched limbs
rows of short repeated strokes along a line
incised/schematic linear figures on a flat rock surface
justification: Both surfaces combine schematic stick-like human figures, a profile animal and prominent concentric circular motifs, and both use rows of short repeated strokes hanging off a curved line, which is a moderately specific correspondence. However, in A the concentric discs are attached to or carried by the figures within a crowded, unbordered scene of boats and crews, while in B the spirals stand alone as the dominant field within a deliberately framed panel with a marginal border, so the relationships and layout differ substantially.
